title: WF03 stage11 releasefix rework1: TC-XC-04-04 deterministic hash test invoked canonical audit hash function with legacy argument order
summary: TC-XC-04-04 called bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash using legacy parameter ordering and types, causing PgError.ServerError on deterministic verification. The test now uses canonical ADP-09/ADP-10 ordering and a fixed timestamp.

root_cause.details: Integration test SQL call passed text where payload_full JSONB is required and used non-canonical argument ordering after audit function reconciliation migration.

commands.command: cmd /c "set BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test&& zig build test-integration-xc04 && echo XC04_EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%"

cmd /c "set BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test&& set BPM_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080&& set BPM_IDP_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8081&& zig build test-integration-stage11-sim-xc04 && echo STAGE11_XC04_EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%"

prevention: When audit-chain SQL signatures evolve, update deterministic integration tests in the same change set.
Prefer fixed timestamps in deterministic hash assertions to avoid time-based drift.
